context_requirements: Active WNT/beta-catenin signaling (nuclear beta-catenin, APC/CTNNB1 mutation or autocrine WNT)
Expression of beta-catenin transcriptional cofactors (CBP/p300, TCF/LEF)
Proliferative or stem-like transcriptional program dependent on beta-catenin
falsifiers: No decrease in MYC or CCND1 at 24 h in HT29 or HEPG2
No induction of AXIN1 or CDKN1A at 6-24 h in any line
Strong proliferation_down signature in HA1E, which lacks active WNT signaling
No difference in response between APC/CTNNB1-mutant lines and WNT-inactive lines

evidence.supports: CBP-beta-catenin inhibition downregulates CD133 and activates PP2A-PTEN in liver cancer cells, indicating beta-catenin-dependent transcriptional output in HEPG2
Boolean network modeling predicts beta-catenin inhibition reduces melanogenesis with minimal apoptotic perturbation, suggesting context-dependent and modest transcriptional effects
